name: Eichenwald Automatik
description: Precision timepieces, crafted for the discerning individual.
story: Eichenwald Automatik has always been driven by a passion for performance and precision, values deeply ingrained in motorsport. As a relatively new entrant to the luxury watch market, they seek to elevate their brand awareness and associate themselves with the thrill and prestige of racing. They believe a successful partnership will expose their timepieces to a sophisticated and performance-oriented audience.
